entities.name: Eugene Czolij
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugene Czolij is a Canadian lawyer of Ukrainian descent who was the elected president of the Ukrainian World Congress (UWC) from 2008 to 2018, the Ukrainian Canadian Congress (UCC) from 1998 to 2004, and the Ukraine-2050 non-governmental organization.
